The tool requires at least one criteria list parameter (functional_groups_broken, formed, bonds, etc). So we need to provide at least an empty list? It says must be provided as a list of strings. So we can provide e.g., functional_groups_broken: [] (empty list) to satisfy. Let's provide both broken and formed as empty lists.

<thought>Provide empty lists for criteria to satisfy requirement and get all templates for the molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CO)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": [],
    "functional_groups_formed": [],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
We hope to get list of templates.
